turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, AcmeBrands customer service here. How may I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi. I was hoping I view the history of my orders but I seem to have lost my username. Can you help me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure thing, can I have your name please?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will also need two of the following: zip code/phone number/email address

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My zip is 39633 and the phone number is (042) 975-9546.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Looks like your username is nbouchard1

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh perfect! I just lose track of them so easily. So many different accounts.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, have a nice day.
